violations.description: COLD AND HOT STORAGE EQUIPMENT (4 pts): Cold holding unit in the facility being used for cold holding temp of 41 degrees F was not functioning adequately. Middle and right hand side reach in coolers by the grill not holding temps. All lettuce and other high risk product was discarded.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Reachin freezer and some coolers' interior not properly maintained.
TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES (1 pts): Reach in coolers noted with no thermometer.

FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floor tiles by the back door and in front of the grill noted in need of repairs. Some ceiling areas in the kitchen and walls by the dishwashing area noted in need of cleaning.

COLD AND HOT STORAGE EQUIPMENT (4 pts): Cold holding unit in the facility being used for cold holding temp of 41 degrees F was not functioning adequately. Under counter reach in cooler by grill noted above 41 degrees F. All product was discarded.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Cutting board not properly maintained. Some reach in cooler interiors noted not properly maintained.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths noted laying on counter in food prep area. Wiping cloths noted not stored in adequate sanitizing solution.
TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES (1 pts): Under grill drawer reach in cooler noted with no thermometer. Reach in coolers noted without thermometers.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Some vent covers in the front kitchen area noted in need of cleaning.
